document.title: Ambassador Dean Cable, "Subject: Congressman Solarz' Meeting with Prime Minister Gandhi, May 28"
document.authors: Ambassador John Gunther Dean, U.S. Embassy New Delhi
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), A New Phase in the Great Game: U.S., Soviets, India, Pakistan vied to shape a new Afghanistan in late 1980s | National Security Archive
document.note: Detailed summary of the Solarz-Gandhi meeting. Covers India-Pakistan relations, Gandhi's questioning of U.S. arms sales (Harpoon, tanks, F-16s) to Pakistan, his suspicions about Pakistan's nuclear weapons, and his view that Gorbachev is ahead of the U.S. on arms proposals.

persons.name: Stephen Solarz
persons.role: U.S. Congressman meeting Indian PM Rajiv Gandhi

mentions.quote: ON MAY 28 I ACCOMPANIED CONGRESSMAN SOLARZ TO A MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER GANDHI.
SOLARZ REITERATED HIS REQUEST THAT ONE OF HIS CONFIDANTS BE GIVEN ACCESS TO THE INDIAN OFFICIALS WHO INTERROGATED
SOLARZ SAID HE PLANNED TO BE BACK EITHER IN NOVEMBER OR DECEMBER
SOLARZ TOLD THE PRIME MINISTER THAT HE THOUGHT THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES WOULD PASS LEGISLATION
RAJIV SAID THAT SINCE HIS TAKING ON THE PREMIERSHIP, HE HAD SEVEN MEETINGS WITH PRESIDENT ZIA.
GANDHI SAID THAT HE PREFERRED TO GIVE THIS EVIDENCE TO SOLARZ DIRECTLY
GANDHI REPLIED THAT JAYEWARDENE HAS "REFUSED TO TAKE A POSITIVE DECISION."
GANDHI OPINED THAT THE PUNJAB COMMISSION REPORT WHICH HE EXPECTS TO BE ISSUED IN JUNE OR JULY

persons.name: John Gunther Dean
persons.role: U.S. Ambassador to India, author of the cable

mentions.quote: I INTERVENED AT THIS STAGE AND POINTED OUT THAT THE STINGER STORY HAD BEEN VIGOROUSLY DENIED
DEAN
RAJIV GANDHI'S DIPLOMATIC ADVISOR, AMBASSADOR GHAREKHAN
SINCE HIS TAKING ON THE PREMIERSHIP, HE HAD SEVEN MEETINGS WITH PRESIDENT ZIA.

persons.name: Benazir Bhutto
persons.role: Pakistani opposition leader recently returned to Pakistan

mentions.quote: ASSESS THE IMPACT OF BENAZIR BHUTTO'S RETURN ON THE PAKISTAN POLITICAL SCENE.
PRIME MINISTER JUNEJO AGREED THAT THE PROGRAM HAD RUN INTO TROUBLE.
SOLARZ THEN CONVEYED ZIA'S AND YAQUB KHAN'S MESSAGES

persons.name: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
persons.role: Former Pakistani PM, father of Benazir (referenced)

mentions.quote: ASKED WHETHER BENAZIR WOULD AVENGE HER FATHER IF SHE EVER CAME TO POWER.

persons.name: Arun Singh
persons.role: Indian Minister of State for Defense

mentions.quote: MINISTER OF STATE FOR DEFENSE ARUN SINGH. AT THAT MEETING ARUN SINGH HAD TALKED ABOUT THE EVIDENCE
GORBACHEV IS RUNNING AWAY WITH THE PUBLIC RELATIONS ASPECT ON U.S.-SOVIET NUCLEAR NEGOTIATIONS.

persons.name: Muammar Qadhafi
persons.role: Libyan leader accused of sponsoring terrorism

mentions.quote: INDIA HAS "NO LOVE FOR QADHAFI." AS A MATTER OF FACT HE CLAIMED THAT LIBYA HAD BEEN HELPING PAKISTAN
HOW DOES MRS. THATCHER HANDLE TERRORISM IN NORTHERN IRELAND?
AT THE LAST MINUTE JAYEWARDENE HAD STEPPED BACK ON THE LAW AND ORDER ISSUE

persons.name: P. Chidambaram
persons.role: Indian emissary who led a mission to Colombo (29 April 1986)

mentions.quote: THE CHIDAMBARAM MISSION HAD RETURNED FROM COLOMBO WITH HIGH HOPES

events.description: Congressman Solarz and Ambassador Dean meet Rajiv Gandhi for one hour.
Solarz met Arun Singh earlier in the day; Singh described evidence of Pakistani support for Punjab terrorists.
Gandhi and Zia drew up a six-step program to improve relations.
Solarz meets Gandhi; discussion of sharing interrogation evidence of Pakistan involvement, Sri Lanka, Punjab, South Africa.
Chidambaram mission to Colombo.
Solarz met Arun Singh earlier in the day; Singh outlined evidence of Pakistani support for Punjab terrorists, from interrogation of 40-50 infiltrators.
Solarz met Gandhi and discussed Pakistan/Punjab, Sri Lanka, Punjab Commission and South Africa; agreed documents be passed via a Solarz emissary or the Indian Embassy in Washington.
Chidambaram's mission to Colombo; returned with high hopes, later set back when Jayewardene stepped back on law and order.
Solarz said he planned to return to India in November or December for a first-hand look at the Sri Lanka problem.
Expected issuance of the Punjab Commission report (June or July).
Solarz expected the House of Representatives to pass anti-apartheid legislation in June.
Ambassador Dean sent the cable reporting the Solarz–Gandhi meeting.
Solarz, accompanied by Ambassador Dean, met PM Rajiv Gandhi and Ambassador Gharekhan for one hour.
Gandhi and Zia drew up a six-step program to improve India-Pakistan relations.
Since July 1985 India protested the budget allocation in Pakistan for the 'liberation of Kashmir'.
Gandhi recently met PM Junejo regarding the stalled six-step program.
Solarz met Benazir Bhutto, Zia and Yaqub Khan in Pakistan before visiting India.
Congressman Solarz meets PM Rajiv Gandhi, discussing arms to Pakistan, nuclear issues, Libya, Punjab.
Solarz earlier met Minister of State for Defense Arun Singh, who presented evidence of Pakistani support for Punjab terrorists, citing 40-50 interrogated infiltrators.
Gandhi proposed an India-Pakistan agreement not to attack each other's nuclear facilities.
US strike on Libya, which India criticized; Dean gave Gandhi evidence of Libyan role in Berlin nightclub bombing.

relationships.detail: Gandhi had seven meetings with Zia since becoming PM.
relationships.quote: HE HAD SEVEN MEETINGS WITH PRESIDENT ZIA.

relationships.detail: Gandhi recently met Pakistani PM Junejo about the six-step program.
relationships.quote: WHEN RAJIV RECENTLY SAW THE PRIME MINISTER OF PAKISTAN AND ASKED HIM ABOUT THE STATUS

relationships.detail: Solarz met Benazir before Gandhi.
relationships.quote: BENAZIR HAD TAKEN THE SAME LINE IN THE COURSE OF HER MEETING WITH SOLARZ

relationships.detail: Earlier meeting on Pakistani support for Punjab militants.
relationships.quote: EXCELLENT MEETING HE HAD EARLIER IN THE DAY WITH MINISTER OF STATE FOR DEFENSE ARUN SINGH

relationships.detail: Gharekhan is Gandhi's diplomatic advisor.
relationships.quote: RAJIV GANDHI'S DIPLOMATIC ADVISOR, AMBASSADOR GHAREKHAN

relationships.detail: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto is Benazir's father.
relationships.quote: WHETHER BENAZIR WOULD AVENGE HER FATHER IF SHE EVER CAME TO POWER

relationships.detail: India alleges Pakistan supports Punjab terrorists; Pakistan denies.
relationships.quote: THE INDIANS HAVE EVIDENCE OF PAK SUPPORT FOR THE TERRORISTS IN THE PUNJAB

relationships.detail: Solarz met Gandhi and requested access to interrogators and documents.
relationships.quote: SOLARZ REITERATED HIS REQUEST THAT ONE OF HIS CONFIDANTS BE GIVEN ACCESS TO THE INDIAN OFFICIALS

relationships.detail: Chidambaram's mission to Colombo; Jayewardene backed off on law and order.
relationships.quote: AT THE LAST MINUTE JAYEWARDENE HAD STEPPED BACK ON THE LAW AND ORDER ISSUE

relationships.detail: EPNLF would give a TULF-accepted agreement a one-year try.
relationships.quote: IF TULF ACCEPTS AN AGREEMENT WITH THE SRI LANKAN AUTHORITIES THE EPNLF WILL "GIVE IT A TRY FOR ONE YEAR."

relationships.detail: Arun Singh is Indian Minister of State for Defense who presented the GOI's evidence on Pakistani support.
relationships.quote: ARUN SINGH HAD TALKED ABOUT THE EVIDENCE THE GOI HAS ON PAK SUPPORT FOR THE TERRORISTS IN THE PUNJAB.

relationships.detail: India alleges Pakistan supports Sikh terrorists in Punjab, based on interrogations of 40-50 infiltrators; Pakistan denies it.
relationships.quote: THE INDIANS HAVE EVIDENCE OF PAK SUPPORT FOR THE TERRORISTS IN THE PUNJAB.

relationships.detail: Alleged Pakistani support to Punjab militants; Pakistan vigorously denied complicity.
relationships.quote: THE PAKS HAVE VIGOROUSLY DENIED ANY COMPLICITY.

relationships.detail: Terrorists operate in Punjab.
relationships.quote: PAK SUPPORT FOR THE TERRORISTS IN THE PUNJAB

relationships.detail: Solarz said Congress could find it harder to appropriate funds for Pakistan if complicity was documented.
relationships.quote: MAKING IT MORE DIFFICULT FOR CONGRESS TO APPROPRIATE FUNDS FOR THE PAK PROGRAM

relationships.detail: Solarz spoke of what the House would pass.
relationships.quote: HE THOUGHT THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES WOULD PASS LEGISLATION SOMETIME IN JUNE

relationships.detail: Gandhi preferred to give the Pakistan-involvement evidence to Solarz directly, through one of his own men, rather than via the U.S. government/Embassy.
relationships.quote: GANDHI SAID THAT HE PREFERRED TO GIVE THIS EVIDENCE TO SOLARZ DIRECTLY

relationships.detail: Solarz suggested the Embassy might help relay the information to him.
relationships.quote: THE EMBASSY MIGHT BE HELPFUL IN RELAYING THE INFORMATION TO HIM.

relationships.detail: Documents to be passed via the Indian Embassy; Solarz to follow up with it within a week.
relationships.quote: SOLARZ WOULD BE IN TOUCH WITH THE INDIAN EMBASSY WITHIN A WEEK OR SO TO FOLLOW UP.

relationships.detail: Gandhi describes stalled negotiations with Jayewardene; Jayewardene refused a positive decision.
relationships.quote: JAYEWARDENE HAS "REFUSED TO TAKE A POSITIVE DECISION."

relationships.detail: Chidambaram's mission to Colombo returned with high hopes, but Jayewardene stepped back on law and order.
relationships.quote: CHIDAMBARAM MISSION HAD RETURNED FROM COLOMBO WITH HIGH HOPES BUT THAT AT THE LAST MINUTE JAYEWARDENE HAD STEPPED BACK

relationships.detail: GSL attacks on Jaffna made resuming negotiations difficult.
relationships.quote: THE GSL ATTACKS ON JAFFNA HAD MADE IT DIFFICULT TO RESUME THE NEGOTIATIONS

relationships.detail: Jayewardene is Sri Lankan president whose government negotiates with India.
relationships.quote: JAYEWARDENE NEEDS TO TALK TO "HIS TAMILS"

relationships.detail: Gandhi is Prime Minister of India.
relationships.quote: THE PRIME MINISTER THEN SPONTANEOUSLY ASSURED SOLARZ

relationships.detail: Gandhi asserted no militant training camps exist in Tamil Nadu and promised to close any found.
relationships.quote: THERE ARE NO TRAINING CAMPS FOR THE MILITANTS IN THE TAMIL NADU.

relationships.detail: EPNLF would reportedly give a TULF-accepted agreement with Sri Lanka a one-year try.
relationships.quote: IF TULF ACCEPTS AN AGREEMENT WITH THE SRI LANKAN AUTHORITIES THE EPNLF WILL "GIVE IT A TRY FOR ONE YEAR."

relationships.detail: TULF is working out an agreement with Sri Lankan authorities.
relationships.quote: WOULD ACCEPT AN AGREEMENT WORKED OUT BY TULF.

relationships.detail: EPNLF is among militant Tamils in Sri Lanka.
relationships.quote: IN-FIGHTING AMONG THE MILITANT TAMILS IN SRI LANKA

relationships.detail: Gandhi expects the Punjab Commission report in June or July to improve the situation considerably.
relationships.quote: PUNJAB COMMISSION REPORT WHICH HE EXPECTS TO BE ISSUED IN JUNE OR JULY

relationships.detail: Gandhi welcomed Solarz's news of U.S. anti-apartheid legislation and said pressure on South Africa is insufficient.
relationships.quote: THE CURRENT LEVEL OF PRESSURE ON SOUTH AFRICA IS INSUFFICIENT

relationships.detail: Dean, signing the cable as ambassador, heads the Embassy.
relationships.quote: DEAN

relationships.detail: Dean accompanied Solarz to a meeting with Prime Minister Gandhi on May 28.
relationships.quote: ON MAY 28 I ACCOMPANIED CONGRESSMAN SOLARZ TO A MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER GANDHI.

relationships.detail: Gharekhan is Gandhi's diplomatic advisor and attended the meeting.
relationships.quote: RAJIV GANDHI'S DIPLOMATIC ADVISOR, AMBASSADOR GHAREKHAN

relationships.detail: Gharekhan serves as Gandhi's diplomatic advisor.
relationships.quote: GANDHI'S DIPLOMATIC ADVISOR, AMBASSADOR GHAREKHAN, NOTED

relationships.detail: Gandhi had seven meetings with President Zia since becoming premier.
relationships.quote: SINCE HIS TAKING ON THE PREMIERSHIP, HE HAD SEVEN MEETINGS WITH PRESIDENT ZIA.

relationships.detail: The two leaders drew up a six-step program to improve relations in December 1985.
relationships.quote: LAST DECEMBER THEY DREW UP A SIX-STEP PROGRAM

relationships.detail: Gandhi recently met Pakistan's PM Junejo and asked about the six-step program.
relationships.quote: WHEN RAJIV RECENTLY SAW THE PRIME MINISTER OF PAKISTAN AND ASKED HIM ABOUT THE STATUS OF THAT SIX=STEP PROGRAM

relationships.detail: Junejo agreed the program had run into trouble; Gandhi offered to restore the pace.
relationships.quote: PRIME MINISTER JUNEJO AGREED THAT THE PROGRAM HAD RUN INTO TROUBLE.

relationships.detail: Solarz met Benazir and discussed relations with India.
relationships.quote: BENAZIR HAD TAKEN THE SAME LINE IN THE COURSE OF HER MEETING WITH SOLARZ

relationships.detail: Solarz conveyed Zia's message to Gandhi, implying he met Zia.
relationships.quote: SOLARZ THEN CONVEYED ZIA'S AND YAQUB KHAN'S MESSAGES

relationships.detail: Solarz conveyed Yaqub Khan's message to Gandhi.
relationships.quote: SOLARZ THEN CONVEYED ZIA'S AND YAQUB KHAN'S MESSAGES

relationships.detail: Gandhi doubts Zia will let Benazir take power; she may cause Zia problems.
relationships.quote: GANDHI DOUBTED THAT ZIA WILL LET BENAZIR COME TO POWER. IT WOULD HAVE TO BE "OVER ZIA'S DEAD BODY."

relationships.detail: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto is Benazir's father.
relationships.quote: WHETHER BENAZIR WOULD AVENGE HER FATHER IF SHE EVER CAME TO POWER

relationships.detail: Benazir foreswore vengeance against Zia and his entourage.
relationships.quote: SHE HAD FORESWORN VENGEANCE AND THAT THIS APPLIED ALSO TO ZIA AND HIS ENTOURAGE

relationships.detail: Junejo is Prime Minister of Pakistan.
relationships.quote: PRIME MINISTER OF PAKISTAN

relationships.detail: Zia is President of Pakistan.
relationships.quote: SEVEN MEETINGS WITH PRESIDENT ZIA

relationships.detail: Both promised party-based elections in 1990.
relationships.quote: BOTH ZIA AND PRIME MINISTER JUNEJO PROMISED THAT IN 1990 THE ELECTIONS WOULD BE ON A PARTY BASIS.

relationships.detail: 120,000 Soviet troops are in Afghanistan.
relationships.quote: AS LONG AS THERE ARE 120 THOUSAND SOVIET TROOPS IN AFGHANISTAN

relationships.detail: Newspaper story claimed Pakistan deployed Stingers on Siachen, denied by Pakistan.
relationships.quote: THE PAKS HAD DEPLOYED STINGERS ON THE SIACHIN GLACIER.

relationships.detail: Dean told Gandhi that Pakistan had denied the Stinger story.
relationships.quote: I INTERVENED AT THIS STAGE AND POINTED OUT THAT THE STINGER STORY HAD BEEN VIGOROUSLY DENIED

relationships.detail: UN mediator reported Soviets might withdraw over 3.5 years versus an original four-year proposal.
relationships.quote: THE UN MEDIATOR HAD REVEALED THAT THE SOVIETS MIGHT BE WILLING TO WITHDRAW OVER A PERIOD OF THREE AND ONE-HALF YEARS

relationships.detail: Pakistan receives US military/economic aid (four billion dollar request) subject to congressional appropriation and legislative language.
relationships.quote: THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH NO LONGER USED THE THREAT FROM AFGHANISTAN AS LEITMOTIF IN JUSTIFYING THE DOLS FOUR BIELION REQUEST

relationships.detail: US aid to Pakistan is tied to US policy in Afghanistan; stopping aid would hinder that policy.
relationships.quote: STOPPING THE U.S. AID PROGRAM TO PAKISTAN WOULD MAKE IT DIFFICULT TO PURSUE OUR POLICY IN AFGHANISTAN

relationships.detail: India must keep pace with new weapons introduced into Pakistani arsenal; nuclear rivalry.
relationships.quote: EVERY TIME NEW WEAPONRY WAS INTRODUCED INTO THE PAK ARSENAL» INDIA WOULD HAVE TO KEEP PACE

relationships.detail: Gandhi had proposed in December that neither country attack the other's nuclear facilities.
relationships.quote: WHAT GANDHI HAD PROPOSED IN DECEMBER OF NEITHER COUNTRY ATTACKING THE OTHER COUNTRY'S NUCLEAR FACILITIES

relationships.detail: Soviets immediately endorse whatever the Delhi Six put forward.
relationships.quote: WHATEVER THE DELHI SIX ARE PUTTING FORWARD IS IMMEDIATELY ENDORSED BY THE SOVIETS

relationships.detail: Gandhi associated with Delhi Six initiative on nuclear disarmament.
relationships.quote: POSITIVE IDEAS WHICH COULD BE EMBRACED BY THE DELHI SIX

relationships.detail: Gorbachev leads Soviet Union's nuclear public relations initiative.
relationships.quote: GORBACHEV IS CONTINUOUSLY MAKING NEW OFFERS

relationships.detail: Gandhi claimed Libya had been helping Pakistan in certain areas.
relationships.quote: HE CLAIMED THAT LIBYA HAD BEEN HELPING PAKISTAN IN CERTAIN AREAS

relationships.detail: Qadhafi is Libya's leader accused of involvement in terrorism.
relationships.quote: THERE WAS ALSO NO DOUBT ABOUT QADHAFI'S INVOLVEMENT IN TERRORISM

relationships.detail: Ambassador handed Gandhi a summary of evidence on Libya's role in Berlin bombing.
relationships.quote: I USED THIS OPPORTUNITY TO HAND THE PRIME MINISTER A ONE-PAGE SUMMARY OF THE EVIDENCE WE HAD ON LIBYA'S INVOLVEMENT

relationships.detail: Gandhi compared US action on Libya to Thatcher's handling of Northern Ireland terrorism.
relationships.quote: HOW DOES MRS. THATCHER HANDLE TERRORISM IN NORTHERN IRELAND?

key_claims: Gandhi told Solarz India prefers democracy in Pakistan but won't interfere in its internal affairs.
Solarz argued US arms to Pakistan are tied to the 120,000 Soviet troops in Afghanistan.
Gandhi doubted US arms would be deployed on the Afghan border rather than the Indian border.
India claims evidence from interrogated infiltrators of Pakistani support for Sikh militants in Punjab.
Solarz said documented Pakistani complicity could make it harder for Congress to fund the Pakistan program.
Gandhi and Solarz agreed Pakistan could produce enough fissile material for a weapon by end of 1986.
Gandhi preferred to give interrogation evidence of Pakistan involvement directly to Solarz via his own man rather than through the U.S. government.
Gandhi denied there are militant training camps in Tamil Nadu and said arms flow cannot be stopped short of a Berlin Wall.
Gandhi blamed Jayewardene for refusing a positive decision in Sri Lanka negotiations.
